version_evidence: No trusted target Dify version or native export evidence was found in the authorized local repository and configuration search.

experience_questions: Can a novice begin with natural chat rather than a parameter form?
Are inspiration, clarification, summary, confirmation, candidate choice, revision, return, and action cards understandable?
Do the two-to-three simulated candidate positions feel structurally distinguishable without a machine-made quality claim?

architecture_questions: Does the shell reference rather than copy identity, fact, authorization, topic-product, and light-plan models?
Can any Dify user value, self-report, or conversation variable widen trusted scope?
Are external runtime claims, readiness, write scope, and the 300/120/86 guards honest?

acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A01: Verify exactly one version-neutral conversation flow and one entry.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A02: Verify ordinary chat cannot create a plan, call prepare/author placeholders, or write brand facts.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A03: Verify inspiration, vague, clear, and exit journeys remain novice-friendly and ask no more than three questions.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A04: Verify prepare/author paths are unreachable before confirmation and after requirement edits until reconfirmed.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A05: Verify only a server-confirmed scope reference unlocks the confirmed placeholder path.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A06: Verify public models and the internal twenty-product mapping are not copied or re-owned.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A07: Verify two-to-three candidates, selected-reference binding, local revision, return, and human-only difference judgment.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A08: Verify missing facts, materials, authorization, and scope produce honest collect, degrade, or block cards without fake body text.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A09: Verify recursive user-visible output does not expose internal identifiers, fields, errors, secrets, or service URLs.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A10: Verify only selected reference, necessary modification, and short reason are retained as feedback.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A11: Re-run the unique checker, selftest, and reverse journeys from the fixed candidate snapshot.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A12: Verify no real Dify/model/API/database/retrieval/cloud calls, all readiness false, allowed write scope only, and 300/120/86 unharmed.
